The '''Battle of Hastings''' was fought on 14 October 1066 between the Norman-French army of William, Duke of Normandy and the English army under King Harold Godwinson.

Harold was killed during the battle, and William became King of England on 25 December 1066.

== Background ==
In 1065, King Edward the Confessor died without an heir.
